text:
Claire Li: PartnerCloud asked for a minimal 'marketplace-iac' reference: one Terraform module + tiny example app + smoke CI. Keep it tiny for their marketplace reviewers.
Ravi Patel: Proposal: new slim repo that pulls shared refkit pieces, but exposes single module `marketplace_shim`. Vars: name,image,region,arch,enable_kms.
Diego Morales: I'll sketch HCL today. Output: listing_id and optional kms_key_id. Example under examples/fastapi with a /health and /invoke endpoint (stubbed).
Maya Chen: Add a short COMPLIANCE.md showing KMS optional block and an audit sink placeholder for their reviewers. KMS off by default.
Claire Li: CI should run terraform fmt, tflint, terraform init/plan (apply in test workspace), spin example container and curl /health. Keep example HCL <200 LOC.
Ravi Patel: Include .tflint.hcl, terraform.lock.hcl, and a README with semver/pinning notes and a one-page onboarding (ONBOARDING.md).
Diego Morales: Draft module main.tf snippet: `required_providers { partner = { source = "partnercloud/partner" version = ">=1.0,<2.0" } }` and a local map for instance_by_arch. Will open PR tomorrow and tag reviewers.
partner-bot: Checklist: https://redwood-internal/partner-checklists/marketplace-mini (auto-post)
Maya Chen: Also include a small matrix in README: supported regions and recommended instance types for arm/x86. Note: avoid GPUs that require special drivers.
Claire Li: Thanks — Ravi + Maya to review. Schedule 30m walkthrough after PR if partner wants live walk-through.
